changelog:
• Channel search is back in Live TV — search the whole playlist, whatever group a channel is in
• Franchise films (Avatar, Dune, Venom) find their releases again — the sequel filter was rejecting every single one
• IPTV guide loads far lighter: no re-download when nothing changed, no memory storms on huge playlists
• Archive is only offered where there is something to play, and it tries alternative addresses before giving up
• Playback no longer hangs on «Loading» forever — you get an error with Retry instead
